title: Synthetic Database Generator
summary: A full-stack web application (Next.js frontend, FastAPI backend) that lets users upload a CSV, preprocess it, and train a generative model to produce synthetic tabular data for domains like healthcare, finance, and retail. Its backend wraps the CTGAN package in a custom CTGANSynthesizer class, so the standalone ctgan library is imported and invoked to perform the actual data generation.
